style: black and white ink line art comic, manga style, clean bold outlines, cross-hatching for shadow, no color, pure white paper background, screentone dots, high contrast, faces drawn cleanly with clear eyes, nose and mouth, correct anatomy

elements.caption: Panel 1, medium shot: a young woman with chin-length black hair and a dark crew-neck sweater sits at a wooden desk late at night, writing in a notebook, a single desk lamp lighting the page, her face clearly drawn and calm
Panel 2, extreme close-up: her right hand holds a fountain pen, the tip hovering just above the paper, a half-written line visible, knuckles slightly tense
thought bubble, cloud-shaped, white fill with a thin black outline, three small circles trailing to the lower left, clean lettering
Panel 3, medium close shot from behind her shoulder: she lifts her head and looks toward the window, rain streaks running down the glass, her face in three-quarter view clearly drawn
thought bubble, cloud-shaped, white fill with a thin black outline, three small circles trailing to the lower right, clean lettering

Panel 4, medium close shot: outside, a man with round glasses in a long coat holds an umbrella and stands still under a street lamp, heavy rain, seen through rain-covered glass, his face clearly drawn
thought bubble, cloud-shaped, white fill with a thin black outline, three small circles trailing to the lower right, clean lettering
